title: Sender
tagline: Example of combining and sending transactions using a Lit Action
description:
Simple tool based on Lit Protocol to programm multichains transactions using Programmable Key Pair (PKP).

Features
 - PKP explorer: mint, search and import PKPs.
 - MPC wallet: using PKPs as a programmable wallet to sign and send multiple transactions.
- Multiple MPC wallets for one account.
how_its_made: Use Lit Protocol to build pragrammable Multi-Party Computation wallet to send and explore multichain transactions. Now, Sender  only supports native tokens on EVM chains. Transactions are signed with Programmable Key Pair and Lit Action. The project is deployed on a VPS and is accessible on the Internet.
